intro.title: Project Introduction
intro.description: Cherry Studio is a multi-platform AI client that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms, with mobile support coming in the future. Since July 2024, the project has released hundreds of updates. We are committed to creating a more efficient, secure, and user-friendly client that allows more people to enjoy the convenience of AI.

items.question: What is Cherry Studio?
items.answer: Cherry Studio is a desktop AI client for macOS, Windows and Linux. It brings 300+ models from 50+ providers into one app, alongside agents, a knowledge base, image generation and translation.

items.question: Does Cherry Studio support MCP (Model Context Protocol)?
items.answer: Yes. Connect MCP servers to give models access to external tools and data sources, and extend the app further with mini-programs.

pricing.subtitle: Built for everyday office work.

badges.title: Lower cost
badges.description: One ${{price}} bill instead of three provider subscriptions, with enough tokens to cover a full month of work.

badges.title: No time or period limits
badges.description: No rolling windows and no daily caps — the allowance is yours for the whole billing month.

badges.title: Transparent pricing and live usage
badges.description: Per-token rates are published below, and current consumption is visible inside the app.

pricing.peak_body: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is billed by time of day. Peak hours are Monday to Friday, 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC; all other times, including weekends, are billed at the off-peak rate. Qwen and GLM use a single rate around the clock.

faq.question: What happens when my allowance runs out?
faq.answer: The plan stops drawing down for that month. You can keep using Cherry Studio with your own provider API keys at any time — the app never locks you out of your own keys.

faq.question: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.answer: Yes. Cancelling stops the next renewal and you keep the remaining allowance until the period ends.

faq.question: Can I get a refund?
faq.answer: If you were charged within the past 14 days and have not used any Flash allowance during that billing period, you may be eligible for a refund. Please contact support@cherry-ai.com to request one.

faq.question: Do I still need accounts with each model provider?
faq.answer: No. That is the point of Flash — one subscription covers the models in the pool, with no separate sign-ups or top-ups per provider.

usage.title: Cherry Flash usage terms
usage.subtitle: A low-cost subscription to open-source models for everyday office work.

intro.title: What Cherry Flash is
body: Cherry Flash is a low-cost subscription that gives you steady access to a curated set of open-source Flash models — for writing, summarising, translation, data work, drafting email and taking meeting notes. The price is whatever the sign-up page shows.

It works like any other model provider. Once you subscribe, the models show up in Cherry Studio’s model selector — there is no API key to configure. It is entirely optional and is not required to use any of our products.
It is designed to be used inside Cherry Studio, where it provides steady model access for everyday office tasks.

background.title: Why we built it
body: Open-source models have become genuinely capable. On everyday office tasks, Flash-class models now perform close to proprietary ones — and because many providers can serve them competitively, they usually cost far less.
Reliable, low-latency access is the hard part. Providers vary widely in both quality and availability.
steps: Tested a curated set of open-source Flash models, and talked to the teams behind them about how best to run each one.
Worked with a number of providers to make sure those models are served correctly.
Benchmarked the model-and-provider combinations, and settled on a shortlist.

how.title: How to use it
body: Once you subscribe, open the model selector in Cherry Studio and pick any model served by the Cherry AI provider. Nothing else to set up.
how.callout: Personal use only. Commercial use is not permitted.

overage.title: Going over the limit

goals.title: What we are aiming for
items: Make AI at work affordable enough that the price is no longer the barrier.
Provide reliable access to the best open-source Flash models for office work.
Curate models that have been tested and benchmarked on everyday office tasks.
No lock-in — you can keep using any other provider alongside Cherry Flash.
